orders.description: Distinct orders whose promise cutoff is in [window_start, window_end).

released_lines.description: Lines released by those orders' latest allocation pass. NOT units.

as_of.description: CloudEvents time of the newest order event the site's model reflects (whole site, not only the window); null when none.

400.description: location missing, window_start/window_end missing or not RFC 3339, or a window whose end is not after its start.
